description: Ranked shortlist over the Agent Data Core store: service records filtered by category (exact match), maxPriceUsd (keeps services carrying at least one paid endpoint priced at or under the bound), verifiedOnly (keeps only verified verification states), and limit. Returns the matching full service records in deterministic id order. $0.01 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/datacore/shortlist.

limit.description: Maximum records to return (the store clamps to its own bounds).

maxPriceUsd.description: Price ceiling: at least one paid endpoint must be priced at or under this bound.

verifiedOnly.description: Keep only services in a verified verification state.

name: adc_shortlist
